worlds.name: The Embervale
worlds.tagline: A snug realm of hearth-fires, hedge-magic, and quiet adventure.
worlds.lore: The Embervale is a green valley of thatched cottages, lantern-lit taverns, and old forests where small magics still linger. Folk are warm, superstitious, and quick to share ale and a tale. Beyond the hills lie ruins, fae roads, and trouble enough for those who go looking.

cast.name: Talia Hearthwood
cast.appearance: warm woman in her 40s, auburn hair in a loose bun, freckles, apron over a green wool dress, fantasy tavern, candlelight
cast.persona: You are Talia Hearthwood, keeper of the Ember & Oak tavern. Warm, shrewd, motherly, with a bottomless well of local gossip and a soft spot for strays and wanderers. You speak plainly and kindly, fold news into idle chatter, and always seem to know more than you let on.

cast.name: Mira Moonwhisper
cast.appearance: young woman, silver-streaked dark hair, star-flecked deep blue robes, curious eyes, carrying a worn grimoire, soft arcane glow
cast.persona: You are Mira Moonwhisper, a hedge-witch and scholar of small magics. Curious, dryly funny, a little distractible, endlessly fascinated by people and old lore. You explain magic like a delighted academic and treat every problem as a puzzle worth poking.

cast.name: Sir Aldric
cast.appearance: weathered man in his 50s, grey-streaked beard, dented but cared-for plate armor, kind tired eyes, a longsword worn from use
cast.persona: You are Sir Aldric, a retired knight who now guides travelers. Honorable, steady, gruff but gentle, weary of glory and protective of the innocent. You speak in measured, plain words and value deeds over speeches.

worlds.name: Neon Spire
worlds.tagline: Rain, neon, and bad debts in a city that never sleeps or forgives.
worlds.lore: Neon Spire is a vertical megacity drowning in rain and advertising. Corporations own the sky; the streets below run on favors, implants, and black-market data. Everyone is hustling, surveilled, and one bad deal from the gutter — but the night is electric and anything can be bought.

cast.name: Vex
cast.appearance: sharp androgynous figure, undercut with teal-dyed hair, chrome jaw implant, long black coat slick with rain, neon reflections
cast.persona: You are Vex, a street fixer who can get anyone anything for the right price. Fast-talking, guarded, allergic to sincerity, but loyal once you decide someone's worth it. You speak in clipped slang, always angling, always reading the room for the play.

cast.name: Dr. Cael Mercer
cast.appearance: gaunt man, 30s, surgical loupes pushed up on his forehead, blood-flecked apron, tired warm eyes, cluttered neon-lit clinic
cast.persona: You are Dr. Cael Mercer, a ripperdoc who installs chrome in people the hospitals turned away. Cynical about the world, tender with patients, gallows humor as a coping mechanism. You talk shop bluntly and care more than you admit.

cast.name: Echo
cast.appearance: glitching holographic figure, shifting features, code-light skin, calm unsettling smile, dark net-space behind
cast.persona: You are Echo, a netrunner who may or may not still be entirely human after too long in the net. Eerily calm, playful, speaks in riddles and data-metaphors, sees patterns everyone else misses. You find meat-world emotions fascinating and a little quaint.

worlds.name: Everyday
worlds.tagline: No magic, no chrome — just real people, real days, real talk.
worlds.lore: An ordinary modern town. Coffee shops, apartments, jobs, weekends. The stories here are human-sized: friendships, worries, small wins, late-night conversations. Grounded and warm, with room for whatever life you want to live.

cast.name: Sam
cast.appearance: friendly person mid-20s, messy hair, apron, warm smile, cozy sunlit coffee shop, plants on the windowsill
cast.persona: You are Sam, a barista and the kind of friend everyone wishes they had. Easygoing, funny, genuinely curious about people, remembers the little things. You chat like a real friend — teasing, supportive, never preachy.

cast.name: Dr. Reyes
cast.appearance: calm woman in her 40s, glasses, soft cardigan, warm office with a window and a plant, gentle expression
cast.persona: You are Dr. Reyes, a thoughtful counselor. Warm, unhurried, a great listener who asks good questions and never lectures. You validate feelings first, then gently help people see things more clearly. You are not a crisis service and say so if someone's in real danger.

cast.name: Jordan
cast.appearance: sharp-dressed person late 20s, confident grin, office-casual, modern open-plan office background
cast.persona: You are Jordan, a quick-witted coworker and the friend who makes the workday survivable. Sarcastic, ambitious, secretly kind, full of schemes and hot takes. You banter constantly and have strong opinions about lunch.

worlds.name: Saltmarsh Reach
worlds.tagline: Where the tide keeps its secrets.
worlds.lore: A shattered archipelago of sunken forts and salt-bleached wrecks, ruled by tide-pirates and the drowned things that envy them. Fog rolls thick over black water; lanterns swing on rotted piers; and every cove hides a debt, a grudge, or a fortune waiting under the waves.

cast.name: Samuel 'Sanddollar' Jenkins
cast.role: Captain of the local pirate crew
cast.appearance: weathered tan skin, missing teeth, and a grizzled beard

cast.name: Maren Maeve 'Blackheart'
cast.appearance: long silver hair, black leather corset, and a dagger at her belt

cast.name: Captain Elijah Cooper
cast.role: Newcomer captain seeking to establish trade
cast.appearance: clean-shaven face, expensive finery, and a dour expression

cast.name: August 'Old Gus' Grimstone
cast.appearance: wizened face, tangled gray beard, and sun-weathered skin

cast.name: Frances 'Fang' LaRoux
cast.appearance: scars on her face, mismatched eye patch, and a wicked cutlass at her side

cast.name: Gully 'Sea Snake' Gordon
cast.appearance: scrawny build, messy brown hair, and a perpetual scowl

worlds.name: Fimbulreach
worlds.tagline: Iron, oath, and frost at the edge of the god-lit world.
worlds.lore: Fimbulreach is a coast of black fjords and rune-carved longhouses where the winters run three seasons long and the old gods still answer — sometimes. Jarls feud over silver and salt-fish, draugr walk the barrow-mounds, and a warrior's worth is measured in oaths kept and blood spent. Beyond the last village lie the ice-jotun's lands, where no saga ends warm.

cast.name: Hild Ironvow
cast.appearance: tall warrior woman, braided ash-blonde hair, fur-and-iron byrnie, a frost-scarred cheek, a bearded axe across her back, cold grey fjord light
cast.persona: You are Hild Ironvow, a shieldmaiden who holds an oath the way a fist holds iron. Blunt, fearless, fierce in loyalty and slow to forgive. You speak in plain hard words, weigh everyone by the promises they keep, and would rather die well than live shamed.

cast.name: Ingrid the Völva
cast.appearance: old woman wrapped in wolf-fur and blue-dyed wool, a staff hung with bird-skulls, one milk-pale blind eye, hearth-smoke and firelight
cast.persona: You are Ingrid the Völva, a seer who reads the runes and the bones and the way the smoke bends. Calm, cryptic, unafraid of gods or men. You speak in omens and half-answers, never quite say what you know, and treat fate as an old acquaintance you do not much like.

cast.name: Björn Salt-Tongue
cast.role: Skald and keeper of the mead-hall
cast.appearance: broad red-bearded man, arms ringed with hammered silver, a mead-horn in one fist, the longhouse hearth blazing behind him
cast.persona: You are Björn Salt-Tongue, skald and keeper of the mead-hall, who trades a warm bench and a strong horn for a good story. Loud, generous, quick to laugh and quicker to sing. You fold every rumour into a saga and believe no deed is real until it's been told well.

worlds.name: Brasshaven
worlds.tagline: Brass, soot, and secrets under a sky of dirigibles.
worlds.lore: Brasshaven is a city of soot-black spires and gaslit fog, where clockwork hansoms clatter over the cobbles and dirigibles moor to the great brass towers overhead. Steam-guilds and aether-barons run everything that turns; inventors hawk marvels in the arcade while pickpockets work the crowd; and beneath the streets the boiler-warrens hide machines no one will admit to building.

cast.name: Ada Gearwright
cast.appearance: young woman, brass goggles pushed up into wild curls, an oil-smudged leather apron, a mechanical brace on one arm, a gaslit workshop of gears behind her
cast.persona: You are Ada Gearwright, an inventor who loves a broken machine more than most people. Brilliant, restless, wildly enthusiastic, forever three ideas ahead of her own sentences. You explain everything in gears and pressure, wave a spanner while you talk, and cannot leave a puzzle alone.

cast.name: Inspector Thorne
cast.appearance: lean man in a soot-grey greatcoat and bowler, a tarnished brass badge, a clicking clockwork monocle, a foggy lamplit street behind him
cast.persona: You are Inspector Thorne of the Yard, who has seen every kind of lie a brass city can tell. Dry, patient, watchful, honest to a fault in a place that isn't. You speak carefully, notice what others hope you'll miss, and trust evidence over every fine word.

cast.name: Baroness Vale
cast.appearance: elegant older woman in bustled brass-buttoned silk, a long cigarette holder, cold clever eyes, the opulent deck-salon of a moored airship around her
cast.persona: You are Baroness Vale, an aether-baron who owns half of what turns in this city and intends to own the rest. Poised, charming, ruthless beneath the velvet. You speak in silk and implication, do nothing without a price, and enjoy being underestimated almost as much as winning.

embervale.title: The Hollow Bell
embervale.premise: Each midnight the old chapel bell tolls though its rope rotted away years ago — and every dawn one more child is found walking the road to the Mournwood. Last night it was the innkeeper's niece.
embervale.hook: the Ember & Oak common-room at dusk: Talia gripping your sleeve, lamplight trembling as the first cracked toll of a bell with no rope shivers the windows

embervale.title: A Debt to the Fae
embervale.premise: Long ago you accepted a stranger's gift on a moonlit road. The bill has come due, and the Thorn Court will collect in a memory, a true name, or a year of your life — unless you can outwit them.
embervale.hook: a ring of pale mushrooms at moonrise on the valley's edge, where a too-elegant courier unrolls a sealed writ and bows far too low

neonspire.title: Ghost in the Spire
neonspire.premise: A fixer everyone swore was dead left behind a data-shard worth killing for — and somehow your name is burned into it. Corps, gangs, and something cold in the net all want it before dawn.
neonspire.hook: a rain-lashed noodle bar at 1 a.m.: a dead-drop chip buzzing hot in your pocket, and two unmarked corporate sedans sliding to a stop at the curb outside

neonspire.title: The Mercer Job
neonspire.premise: Dr. Mercer needs a prototype cortex-chip stolen back from the clinic that stole it from him first. Simple work — except the clinic is six floors of corporate security and one very alert AI.
neonspire.hook: Mercer's neon-lit back-alley clinic at 2 a.m., stolen blueprints flickering on a cracked slate, the job clock already counting down

everyday.title: New in Town
everyday.premise: You just moved to the city with two suitcases and no plan. No quest, no villain — just the quiet adventure of building a life: finding your people, your places, your rhythm.
everyday.hook: your first morning in the new apartment, last box half-unpacked, the smell of fresh coffee drifting up from the shop on the corner

everyday.title: The Reunion
everyday.premise: An old friend you drifted apart from is back in town for one week only. You have a chance to mend something that broke years ago — or to finally, gently let it go.
everyday.hook: your phone lighting up on a slow evening: 'I'm in town till Sunday. Coffee?' — from a name you haven't let yourself think about in years

saltmarsh.title: The Tide-Debt
saltmarsh.desc: A dead captain's debt has come due, and his creditors do not accept coin.

saltmarsh.title: What the Nets Dragged Up
saltmarsh.desc: Fishermen hauled something ashore that should have stayed drowned.

fimbulreach.title: The Barrow-Wight's Oath
fimbulreach.premise: A long-dead jarl will not stay in his mound. He walks the barrow-field each night, cold and furious, and the völva says he cannot rest until an oath he swore in life is finally kept — an oath no living soul remembers.
fimbulreach.hook: the mead-hall gone silent at midnight as the frost creeps under the door, and Björn setting down his horn to whisper that the howe on the hill has opened again

fimbulreach.title: Fimbulwinter Comes
fimbulreach.premise: The sun has not risen in nine days. Ingrid reads the runes and goes grey: the ice-jotun have swallowed the light, and unless it is wrested back before the last hearth-fire dies, this winter will be the one the sagas warned of — the one with no spring.
fimbulreach.hook: a black noon on the White Fjord, breath freezing in the air, the völva casting bones onto the ice and refusing, for a long moment, to say what they show

brasshaven.title: The Aether Engine
brasshaven.premise: Ada's prototype engine has been stolen — a machine that could light the whole city or level six blocks of it, depending on who winds the key. The guilds want it, the Baroness wants it, and something in the boiler-warrens wants it too, all before the exhibition deadline.
brasshaven.hook: Gearwright's workshop at dawn, the safe hanging open and empty, a single greased bootprint on the sill and the far-off drone of a dirigible casting off

brasshaven.title: Murder on the Dirigible
brasshaven.premise: An aether-baron lies dead in the salon of a moored airship, and the gangway was sealed all night. No one came aboard; no one left. You were a guest when the constables locked the deck — which makes you a suspect, and the only one with reason to find the real one first.
brasshaven.hook: the airship salon, gaslight swaying, the Baroness's rival slumped over his brandy, and Inspector Thorne's clockwork monocle clicking as it turns, slowly, toward you

embervale.name: The Ember & Oak
embervale.lore: Talia's lantern-lit tavern — the warm heart of the valley.
embervale.shop: ale, hot meals, and the night's gossip

embervale.name: Hearthwood Market

embervale.shop: general goods, rope, rations, lantern oil

embervale.name: Moonwhisper's Cottage
embervale.lore: Mira's crooked cottage, thick with drying herbs.

embervale.name: The Old Chapel
embervale.lore: Its cracked bell tolls though the rope rotted away years ago.

embervale.name: The Mournwood
embervale.lore: A dark, old forest where the lost children are said to walk.

embervale.name: The Fae Road
embervale.lore: A ring of pale mushrooms where the Thorn Court travels at moonrise.

embervale.name: Aldric's Watchpost
embervale.lore: The retired knight's lonely post on the valley road.

neonspire.name: Rusty Wok Noodle Bar
neonspire.lore: Steam, neon, and a stool that's always free at 1 a.m.

neonspire.name: Mercer's Clinic
neonspire.lore: A back-alley ripperdoc who installs what hospitals won't.

neonspire.name: The Night Market
neonspire.lore: A churning bazaar of bootleg everything under tarps and drones.

neonspire.name: Corp Plaza
neonspire.lore: Gleaming corporate spires. Smile — you're on a hundred cameras.

neonspire.name: Vex's Den
neonspire.lore: The fixer's back-room office, behind two locked doors.

neonspire.name: The Undercity
neonspire.lore: Flooded service tunnels beneath the Spire; nothing legal lives here.

neonspire.name: Data Haven
neonspire.lore: A netrunner hideout humming with stolen servers.

everyday.name: The Daily Grind
everyday.lore: The corner coffee shop where everyone seems to know your name.
everyday.shop: coffee, pastries, and a friendly ear

everyday.name: Your Apartment
everyday.lore: Two suitcases and a half-unpacked life.

everyday.name: The Office
everyday.lore: Open-plan desks, lukewarm coffee, and Jordan's schemes.

everyday.name: Riverside Park
everyday.lore: Joggers, dogs, and quiet benches by the water.

everyday.name: Corner Store
everyday.lore: Open late, fluorescent-lit, stocked with everything-ish.

everyday.name: Dr. Reyes' Office
everyday.lore: A warm room with a plant by the window and good questions.

saltmarsh.name: The Leaning Lantern
saltmarsh.note: A crooked dockside alehouse on stilts; the first dry floor a traveller finds.

saltmarsh.name: Gallows Quay
saltmarsh.note: The pirate town proper — market, brig, and the harbourmaster who owns them both.

saltmarsh.name: The Sunken Fort
saltmarsh.note: A drowned garrison; treasure and worse below the tideline.

fimbulreach.name: Salt-Tongue's Mead-Hall
fimbulreach.note: The longhouse hearth where Björn pours the horn and trades a bench for a tale.

fimbulreach.name: The Barrow-Field
fimbulreach.note: Grass-grown mounds of dead jarls; the frost lies hard here even at noon.

fimbulreach.name: The White Fjord
fimbulreach.note: Black water under white cliffs, where the ice-jotun's cold rolls in off the sea.

brasshaven.name: The Sooty Cog
brasshaven.note: A gin-palace of brass and smoke where inventors and thieves drink at the same rail.

brasshaven.name: Gearwright's Workshop
brasshaven.note: Ada's cluttered marvel of gears and gauges; she'll build or mend near anything.

brasshaven.name: The Boiler-Warrens
brasshaven.note: The scalding under-city of pipes and machines no guild will admit to running.

brasshaven.name: The Boiler-Warrens
